title: Roman theater of Fioccaglia
description: Crop marks, confirmed by a magnetometer survey reported in 2026, demonstrate the location and footprint of a monumental theater at the archaeological site of Fioccaglia di Fumeri.

properties.description: Crop marks identified in Google Earth with reference to Italian Ministry of Culture imagery overlaying magnetic survey data on an orthophotomap as published in ANSA.it in February 2026.
properties.title: Imagery Location: center of crop marks associated with Roman theater
